title: Design: long and special category names on the list and the page
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, with a long name with spaces that no other record of that kind has, at least 50 characters (for example Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment Fleet Pricing Plan).
  • Have a new category for this test, category B, with a long name with no spaces, at least 50 characters (for example NorthernAlbertaHeavyEquipmentFleetPricingPlanTier).
  • Have a new category for this test, category C, with a name with the characters & " ' < > in it (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Tier>).
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Category A's, category B's and category C's names stay inside the Category column of their own rows, wrapped if needed, and never cover the Pricing Matrix column.
  • Every column stays visible and the page does not scroll sideways.
  • Category C's name shows character for character as typed, & " ' < > included.
  • The column headings keep their places, as in picture 7.3.

Step 2:

  • Category B's name shows as the page title without covering the three-dot button or New Matrix.
  • The breadcrumb, the Pricing Matrix picker and the page stay inside the window; the page does not scroll sideways.
